title: Write in y = form
text:
Start with the function:
$f(x) = 3x - 6$

Write as: $y = 3x - 6$

title: Interchange Variables
text:
To find the inverse, swap $x$ and $y$:

Original: $y = 3x - 6$
Interchanged: $x = 3y - 6$

title: The Interchanged Equation
text:
After interchanging $x$ and $y$:

$x = 3y - 6$

This is the first step to finding the inverse.
